entities.name: Clément Ducol
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Clément Ducol is a French multi-instrumentalist, composer and arranger. As a film score composer, he is most noted for his work on the films Chicken for Linda! , for which he received a Lumière Award nomination for Best Music at the 29th Lumière Awards, and Emilia Pérez, for which he and Camille Dalmais won the Cannes Soundtrack Award at the 2024 Cannes Film Festival as well as the Academy Award for Best Original Song.
